findings.problem: The text says the built-in small-fragment filter is independent of minFragmentSize, but the source applies that static filter only in the elif branch when minFragmentSize is not greater than 0.
findings.evidence: Source: if minFragmentSize > 0: ... elif pSmi.replace('*', '').replace('()', '') in ('', 'C', 'CC', 'CCC'): ...
findings.impact: Users who set minFragmentSize>0 may incorrectly expect the static filter to still apply, changing predicted leaves or empty results.
findings.action: Revise the paragraph to state that the static filter applies only when minFragmentSize=0; when minFragmentSize>0 the numeric threshold check is used instead.
